prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: your lax terminal is already a disaster. This is icing on the cake. Looking forward to a long layover with infant without sky club.
Delta: Hi there. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Please follow/DM your confirmation code or tkt # for any assistance. *TKR

Customer: I'm at  Sky Club in Minneapolis, MN https://t.co/q2RakrUrSt
Delta: Happy to have you, Stevan.  *AST

Customer: This is not the first time  Sky Club has saved my ass.  :-)
Delta: We're happy to hear this, Robert! Thank you so much, from all us, for your continued loyalty.  *TJH

Customer: Well done  on the SEA Sky Club, if only I had time to check out the spa. https://t.co/0BaawREO6M
Delta: Hi, James. Thanks for sharing the photo. The Sky Club looks awesome! 😄 *TJF

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: loyalty_refund_compensation):
""". my flight from Zurich was canceled and Now my layover in JFK is extremely long. Would like to request a sky club pass"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry for the inconvenience. Please DM us your confirmation code or ticket number so we can assist you with a Sky Club pass.
